query:
SELECT 
  'mentorProfiles' as table_name,
  COUNT(*) as total_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN uuid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as null_uuid_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN uuid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as valid_uuid_count
FROM mentor_profiles
WHERE "isDeleted" = false

UNION ALL
